🏢 MI HB 6426 — Data Centers Could Hit Pause in Michigan

Large data centers with a projected energy load of 25 megawatts or more, or those expanding to that level, will face stricter local review in Michigan. This bill establishes key definitions – like ‘large-scale data center’ and ‘local decision’ – and sets a process for developers seeking approval. ...
